messages:
Raj P: Heads up — after the 550 driver staggered rollout started in eu-west this morning, ~6/120 GPU nodes failed to finish provisioning and are stuck in 'provisioning' state. Seen DKMS build failures in cloud-init and some NCCL nvlink timeouts. Anyone seen this? @Marta L @Infra Oncall

Alice M: How many GPUs total affected and which instance types?

Raj P: 24 GPUs total (6 nodes x 4 gpus). Instances: a2-highgpu-1g and a2-highgpu-4g mainly. Kernel on those nodes: 6.1.0-101-custom. Cloud-init shows nv-dkms build error.

Marta L: paste logs?

Raj P: ```
cloud-init[1234]: nvidia-dkms: ERROR (dkms apport): kernel cleanup failed
nvidia: running module version sanity check
error: Bad return status from /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550.24.05/build/make...
```

Alice M: Do we have same issue in us-east/asia?

Infra Oncall: Not in us-east; eu-west only so far. Rollout was staggered by region — looks like eu-west batch hit a nodepool that had newer custom kernel (6.1.0-101-custom).

Marta L: If DKMS fails, node can't load nvidia module => kubelet marks node NotReady and nvidia-device-plugin won't register GPUs. Workaround: use image with prebuilt modules or pin driver to 535 for that pool.

Infra Oncall: Rolled back the driver rollout for that pool to 535 — new nodes provision OK now. But autoscaler already queued replacements and we have ~18 pending spot requests because taints block scheduling. Capacity hit ~40 GPUs short across eu-west for the next ~10m.

Raj P: Is there a known nvlink / NCCL incompat with 550 + kernel-6.1? I see repeated dmesg entries: 'NCCL WARN NVLINK: nvlink detect timeout' and some 'nvlink reset' traces.

Marta L: Could be firmware/kernel-headers mismatch or CUDA toolkit vs driver mismatch. Also check that DKMS is pointing at the right kernel headers path — custom kernels sometimes don't have /lib/modules/<ver>/build symlink.

Alice M: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon affected nodes; 2) scale up other healthy pools in us-east temporarily; 3) pin new eu-west nodepool to 535 and reprovision.

Infra Oncall: Doing 1/3 now. Scaling us-east by +6 nodes (adds ~48 GPUs). ETA ~8m.

DeployBot: rollout/driver-550/eu-west batch: paused by Infra Oncall at 1925000205.

Raj P: Thanks. I'll open a brief incident note and include hypothesis about kernel-header mismatch and nvlink timeouts. We should add a smoke-provision job that uses a custom-kernel image before allowing driver rollouts to that pool. @Alice M can you add to infra playbook?

Alice M: Yep, will add a smoke-provision job in the CI that boots one node with the target kernel + driver and runs DKMS build check + nvidia-smi quick smoke. Also adding a logmon alert for 'dkms build failed' to trigger on provision.

Marta L: Also adding a node-health check for 'nvlink detect timeout' and flagging that as a warning in the node dashboards.

Infra Oncall: Update — rollback complete, pending nodes draining, autoscaler started fulfilling replacements from healthy pools. Monitoring for 1h. :thumbsup:
